name: NA64 Collaboration

formation.note: The official site's timeline starts with the January 2014 proposal; this is used as a lower bound for collaboration formation, not a stated formation date for the collaboration itself as a body.

summary.plain: The team of physicists running the NA64 dark-sector search at CERN.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the NA64 active beam-dump experiment at CERN; the official site links participant information to the CERN Greybook rather than stating a headline institution/country/member count itself, so membership counts are left null.

notes: No official membership count found; the collaboration page links to the CERN Greybook, which is a client-rendered app not fetchable for a verbatim number this session.
